0022600027.text: The Cavaliers (4-4, sixth in the East, on a two-game losing streak) host the Philadelphia 76ers (8-1, first in the East, on a five-game winning streak) in this NBA Cup East Group B game, Cleveland's ninth of the season. Jaylon Tyson is out with an ankle sprain for Cleveland, while Jarrett Allen, Peyton Watson and Tyrese Proctor are day-to-day with knee, hamstring and ankle issues and are game-time decisions. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), and Adem Bona is day-to-day with a back sprain and a game-time decision. Philadelphia won the only meeting so far this season 114-106 in Philadelphia on October 22, while Cleveland won all four matchups in 2025-26.
